title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
hook_text: Meta's new AI on your desktop
script:
Meta just launched its most capable open-weight AI model called Muse Spark.
It is the first model in its class that runs directly on your desktop.
You need two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios to power it.
This setup relies on Apple's latest MLX framework to manage the load.
Meta claims this model outperforms every other US open-weight model available today.
This eliminates the need for expensive cloud GPU clusters.
Would you buy two Mac Studios just to run this AI locally?

editor.one_line: Major factual error regarding hardware availability makes this reel unusable for news.
script_fixes: LINE 3: Correct the hardware claim; the M5 Ultra does not exist yet, making the entire premise factually impossible.
LINE 1: Specify 'Meta's new open-weight model' instead of just 'Meta' to be more precise.
visual_notes: line 1: The same static image of a Mac Studio is held for too long (over 7 seconds).
line 3: The visual shows a generic Apple logo instead of the specific hardware mentioned.
